objects.description: During [Operation Digital Eye](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0061), threat actors used custom implementations of [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002).(Citation: sentinelone operationDigitalEye Dec 2024)
objects.description_fa: در طول [عملیات Digital Eye](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0061)، عوامل تهدید از پیاده‌سازی سفارشی [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002) استفاده کردند.(Citation: sentinelone operationDigitalEye Dec 2024)
